learn.prompt: The equation is x + 7 = 12. Which move isolates x without breaking equality?
learn.hint: Undo the +7 by doing the inverse operation to the whole equation.
learn.explanation: Subtract 7 from both sides: x + 7 − 7 = 12 − 7, so x = 5.

options.label: Subtract 7 from the left side only

misconceptionMap.b: Changing only one side breaks the equality. Every move applies to both sides.
misconceptionMap.c: Adding 7 makes the constant larger, moving away from isolating x.
misconceptionMap.d: Dividing by 7 does not undo an added 7.

learn.prompt: Solve x + 5 = 12 by keeping the scale balanced.
learn.explanation: Subtracting 5 from both sides gives x = 7.

learn.prompt: Solve 3x = 15 by keeping the scale balanced.
learn.explanation: Dividing both sides by 3 gives x = 5.

check.prompt: Solve x + 9 = 14 by keeping the scale balanced.
You add 4 to the left side of an equation and nothing else. What happens?
check.hint: An equation is a statement that both sides have the same value.
check.explanation: The two sides no longer have the same value, so the equality is broken.

misconceptionMap.a: Equality survives only when the same operation is applied to both sides.
misconceptionMap.c: Changing one side changes the value, so the solution changes.

takeaway.title: Equality is a promise
takeaway.body: Whatever you do to one side, do to the other. Undo operations in reverse order until the variable stands alone.
